NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL (Government Code Section

TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL

NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a special meeting of the City Council will be held on Tuesday,
August 24, 2021, at 2:30 P.M., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California
(Government Code Section 54956)

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the
social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N -29-20
(https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20 -N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council at the Special
Meeting of August 24, 2021, at 2:30 P.M. for open session as follows:

Inglewood, California
  August 24, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  August 24, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into session at the hour of 2:30 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and
  Mayor Butts; and
  Absent:  None.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Jeffery Lewis  Senior Assistant City Attorney
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager/CFO
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on this matter.

  There was no response.

301  FIRST AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 21-185 APPROVED – BHAGAT
  INVESTMENTS – CENTURY, LLC; MAYOR AUTHORIZED TO SIGN THE
  AMENDMENT. Staff report dated August 24, 2021, was presented recommending
  approval of the First Amendment to Development Agreement, amending the June 29,
  2021 Development Agreement No. 21-185 between the City of Inglewood and Bhagat
  Investments – Century, LLC, a California limited liability company, concerning the
  acquisition and development of the hotel as part of the IBEC Project.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Morales
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve First Amendment to Agreement No. 21-
  185; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to sign the Amendment. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 2:33 p.m.

  Approved this ________ day of ____________ 2021

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ____________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
